## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng commentary on the *Bā shí guījǔ sòng* 八識規矩頌 by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** (1599–1655). Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0895. Part of Zhìxù's *zhíjiě* set of compact direct expositions of the late-Míng Yogācāra core curriculum, alongside [KR6n0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0106) *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn zhíjiě*, [KR6n0115](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0115) *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn zhíjiě*, [KR6n0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0117) *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn shì zhíjiě*, and [KR6n0145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0145) *Xiàngzōng bā yào zhíjiě*.

**Abstract**

The *Zhíjiě* is the most concise and pedagogically polished of the late-Míng *guījǔ* commentaries — designed for direct use in teaching. Zhìxù reads each verse with a brief, doctrinally precise gloss, with the broader integrative *xìngxiàng* synthesis kept in the background and the foreground occupied by clear definition and example. Where Hānshān's [KR6n0135](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0135) *Tōngshuō* opens the text out into the *yīxīn* doctrine and Pǔtài's [KR6n0131](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0131) *Bǔzhù* loads the verses with the full Cí'ēn-school technical apparatus, Zhìxù's *Zhíjiě* finds the middle path: each verse is glossed precisely enough for the doctrine to be unambiguous, but compactly enough for the student to retain the verse as a mnemonic. This is the *guījǔ* commentary most frequently used in modern Chinese Buddhist seminaries.

The dating window 1630–1655 brackets Zhìxù's productive period after his major doctrinal turn around 1631.
